notes: Static pre-execution admission filter only. Keyword matching is NOT a security boundary; isolation is enforced by the worker container contract (US-006/US-008). Env deny-list stops candidate submissions from overriding server-assigned execution fields (EXECUTION_COMMAND/JOB_*), dynamic-loader hijacks (LD_*, PYTHONPATH), interpreter/platform path bypasses (PATH, HOME, PYTHONHOME, PYTHONUSERBASE, CDPATH), worker-control/configuration variables (WORKER_*, REDIS_*, DB_*, POSTGRES_*, DOCKER_*, SANDBOX_API*), or gate/evaluator/budget configuration (SOURCE_GATE_*, EVALUATOR_*, BUDGET_*). v2: platform/loader bypass keys and worker-control prefixes added; data_dir and path-valued environment values are traversal/protected-component checked by validate_job_fields.
